title: GTA 6 hits 99 on Metacritic and ties the all-time record
summary: Reviews are out and GTA 6 sits at 99, level with Ocarina of Time as the best-reviewed game Metacritic has ever listed.
body: The review embargo lifted on 18 November at 6 am ET (11:00 GMT), the same moment the game unlocked in New Zealand. Within hours GTA 6 was sitting at 99 on Metacritic.
- 99/100 on Metacritic, matching The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time from 1998
- Around 110 critic reviews at first count, rising past 140 later in the day
- Early count: roughly four out of five reviews were a perfect 10, and nothing below 90
- OpenCritic: 100% of critics recommend it, top critic average 98
- Driving and traffic that feel heavier and more alive than GTA V
- Lighting and detail that several outlets call a new benchmark for open worlds
- Jason and Lucia's story, with its pull between desperation and easy crime money
- A huge, dense Leonida that rewards wandering off the mission path
- A few reviewers mention minor performance hiccups
- Consoles run at 30 FPS with no 60 FPS mode at launch, even on PS5 Pro

Scores can still slip a point as late reviews land, but this is about as strong a launch as a game can get. If you were waiting for the verdict, this is it. Our tips and mission help go up here from launch night.
